cobblemon.species.reginant.name: Reginant
cobblemon.species.reginant.desc: The queen of a Durant colony. It rules the anthill from its deepest chamber and only leaves it if the nest is destroyed. Female Durant fed on the colony's fungus become queens.
message.ecosystems_untamed.reginant_not_: Only female Durant at level 35 or higher can become a queen.
